versions.changelog:
- Changes the skill to support read-only workflows by default; billing actions are no longer supported directly in this skill.
- Removes credential auto-discovery; user must provide API key explicitly if needed.
- Never performs billing POST actions, even with user confirmation.
- Buy/funding flows are now strictly out-of-band; users are directed to external checkout links.
- Clarifies the 402 recovery playbook for read-only usage only.
- Updates descriptions, credential policy, and safety guidance to reflect these restrictions.

Version 1.0.2

- Removed the unused environment variable OMNIS_AGENT_API_BASE_URL from requirements.
- No other changes detected.

- Updated billing flow to require explicit user approval before any payment actions.
- Added credential requirements for API key and endpoint configuration.
- Clarified consent policy: all billing POSTs now require confirmation, with payload/charge preview.
- Enhanced 402 recovery to present checkout URLs and always ask for user confirmation before proceeding.
- Adjusted descriptions and guidance to emphasize read-only operations unless explicitly authorized for billing.

Initial release of Omnis Venture Intelligence.

- Enables machine-first discovery, scoring, and funding of venture opportunities.
- Provides a clear 3-step onboarding using API: capabilities, status, and value-proof.
- Supports autonomous funding via API-native checkout and robust 402/429 error handling.
- Offers a mapped set of production and billing endpoints for high-signal venture workflows.
- Emphasizes operational automation—retry guidance, rate limit handling, and concise endpoint summaries.
